title: The Monkey's Paw

teacherSummary.text: Sergeant-Major Morris brings the Whites a mummified monkey's paw from India, cursed by a fakir to grant three wishes to three men. Mr. White wishes for two hundred pounds. The next day their son Herbert is killed in machinery at work, and the company pays two hundred pounds. Mrs. White makes her husband wish Herbert alive. A knocking comes at the door; as she unbolts it, Mr. White uses the last wish, and the road outside is empty.
